recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast surrealist composition featuring a central figure in vibrant red avant-garde attire against a desaturated, stormy blue-grey sky filled with black crows. The figure is posed in a contorted, sculptural manner on a reflective dark surface, with large crows interacting with the subject's limbs.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant red subject vs. desaturated blue-grey environment
Organic, sharp silhouettes of birds vs. smooth, architectural fashion curves
Reflective dark ground plane vs. atmospheric, cloudy sky
Wide, airy typography vs. dense, chaotic bird swarms
coreInvariants: Stormy, overcast lighting with cool tones
Multiple black crows in varying scales

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central lower-third placement, subject occupies approximately 50% of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large circular red collar framing the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large crow on the left, follows the leg up to the hand, moves across the red collar to the face, then follows the smaller birds into the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant atmospheric space in the upper two-thirds of the frame to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the central subject against low saturation, mid-value background creates a 'pop' effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to Red, Black, and Blue-Grey

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and tracking widths for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, geometric, and modern feel of the display text.
Provides the clean, monolinear geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal image of a woman in a sculptural, bright red avant-garde outfit with a large circular collar. She is posed on a black reflective floor. The background is a dark, stormy blue-grey sky filled with a swarm of black crows. One large crow is perched on her raised red heel. The lighting is cool and cinematic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered white text in the upper third of the image. The top line should be a large, ultra-extended geometric sans-serif with wide tracking. The second line should be much smaller, also in all-caps geometric sans-serif, with even wider letter-spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the red outfit the only high-saturation element?
Are the birds black and silhouetted against the sky?
Is the text centered and extremely wide?
Is there a clear reflection on the floor?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the sky's blue-grey tint
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos or specific artist names

mustAchieve: Distinct separation between red subject and blue background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red color does not bleed into the sky.
Check that the typography does not overlap the birds or the subject.
Verify the floor reflection matches the subject's pose.
Confirm the sky has a stormy, atmospheric texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surreal High-Fashion + Avian Swarm + Geometric Extended Typography + High-Contrast Triad Palette (Red/Black/Slate)
